label: Tape stop
clause: Tape-stop a bar so the grid melts down before the next section.

label: Riser
clause: Rise a noise so the drop is announced without a vocal.

label: Vinyl stop
clause: Vinyl-stop so the record feels grabbed.

label: Reverse cymbal
clause: Reverse a cymbal so the swell is backward metal.

label: Bitcrush
clause: Bitcrush a throw so the crunch is a low-depth cousin.

label: Filter open
clause: Open a filter so the chorus arrives as brightness.

label: Filter close
clause: Close a filter so the verse is small.

label: Impact
clause: Impact a low hit so the section change is a body punch.

label: Glitch stutter
clause: Glitch-stutter a grain so the fill is a broken repeat.

label: Rewind
clause: Rewind a bar so jungle energy can jump back.

label: Silence gap
clause: Gap a silence so the next hit is larger.

label: White sweep
clause: Sweep white noise so the transition is air not a chord.

label: Sub drop
clause: Drop a sub so the downbeat has a fall-in.

label: Pitch up
clause: Pitch-up a fill so the energy climbs a tone.

label: Pitch down
clause: Pitch-down a fill so the energy sags into the hook.

label: Granular wash
clause: Wash granular so the pad is particles.

label: No FX
clause: Skip transition FX so the cut is a hard edit.

label: Sting hit FX
clause: Hit a sting so two bars can ident a show.

label: Bed-safe none
clause: Skip drop FX so a speech bed never dumps a club transition.

label: Zap
clause: Zap a short tone so the fill is comic without a cartoon brand.

label: Formant grind
clause: Grind a formant so the bass talks through a scrape instead of a sung vowel.

label: Kick split
clause: Split the kick so tearout has a broken downbeat under the growl.
